context: `inviteTeamMember` mutation lets an authenticated user send an email invite to join their team. It currently has no rate limiting.
explanation: Safe to merge. Wrapping the resolver with `rateLimiter`, keyed by the authenticated user's id rather than by IP, caps how many invite emails a single account can trigger per hour — closing off both accidental spam loops and deliberate abuse (using the invite mutation as a free mail relay) without affecting other users sharing the same IP.
